notes: NNS-core is the portable C++ extraction of the R NNS src layer. The R repo remains authoritative. r_commit/r_src_tree_hash identify the R src tree the core was ported from (original_src/ holds the corresponding R files byte for byte); core_commit is the last NNS-core commit that ported numerics from it. `r_bug_fixes` lists R bugs that NNS-core fixes ahead of R: there the core intentionally differs from this r_commit, and the fidelity suite tags the affected cases with `r_fix`.
